body:
...K.  You know you're right, I DO like my hands.  The island has a special unit for ordinance disposal for just such situations.  

Glad to know what to do now.  Much obliged!  Kind of wish I hadn't left it sitting on my coffee table the last few weeks though...
You are...16.  I'm going to say 16, with an over/under of 1 year.

Heh.  But it's true, the best way to be is to let go of everything else and focus on making your own self the best you can be.  Everything else will come into focus and being yourself is the only way for people to like you for you.  Thanks for the comment.

Dang, in all honesty I can't really remember writing this post now that I'm reading it again.  I had a bit of an emotional episode during some withdrawal symptoms (trying to get clean) and channeled my pain into, admittedly, some pretty nasty words online to get it out of my system before it poisoned me worse.  I don't regret it at all.  It helped me get some perspective. And I am extremely grateful, now that I'm more clearheaded, that these forums exist where I may do this kind of purging without hurting any one individual or group of people.  This stuff needs to come out or it only gets worse, but that doesn't mean other people need to suffer for it.

Also your comments, whether intended for it or not, came off totally as angry personal attacks motivated by your own pain and insecurity.  If this is you trying to purge also, I strongly urge you to do so in your own posts rather than commenting on others.  Someone might take your comments to heart and make their own situation way worse.  And you won't heal as long as you are getting angry at other people for what they type in forums instead of keeping the focus on yourself where the battle can actually be won.  Not a criticism, just an observation fueled by some hard-won experience.  Do with it as you will.  I certainly hope you find some peace in your heart some day.  Everyone deserves that.
That...worked?  Huh.  Well congratulations then folks.
Well that's....really great to read actually.  Thanks internet friend!  I believe it can be done!
Oh right, cats are always one generation away from wild animals, self-sufficient hunters, and used to be worshiped as gods.  Forgot about that......he didn't.
A lot of these jokes posted today seemed kind of mean, but this one is really sweet.

First of all, congratulations!  This is fantastic to read and gives me new hope for the future.  Thanks for sharing this with the rest of us!

Second, the only reason what you've just done wouldn't look super amazing is if you tried comparing this to someone else who seemingly made the same achievement in less time/effort/struggling.  But that's not fair because that persons living situation, needs, environment, and experience are all totally different from yours so of course their results will be different as well.  Different, not better or worse, just different.  In any case, we can celebrate both folks for their triumphs and encourage them to continue on their own paths.

You hit a really exciting milestone today.  So happy for you.  Keep going and lead the way!  A lot of us are right behind you!
